title: Repeated or Centered PDF Watermark? Choose the Coverage
description: Choose a repeated PDF watermark when the purpose mark should appear across the page; choose one centered mark when a simple document-status stamp is enough.
direct: Use one centered mark when a clear stamp is enough. Choose repeated marks when status needs to remain visible across more of the page and the content stays readable.

cards.choice.heading: Start with the decision
cards.choice.body: A short word such as DRAFT can work as one centered stamp. A repeated purpose mark spreads the wording over more of the sheet. Neither layout prevents someone from copying, editing or photographing the document, and neither replaces redaction.
sections.detail-0.heading: Coverage is not security
sections.detail-0.body: A repeated pattern may remain visible in more cropped portions of a page than a single stamp. That is an observation about placement, not tamper resistance. Do not cover details the recipient must read, or assume a purpose statement controls what happens to the file. Confirm the recipient accepts visible marks before preparing a sensitive application.
sections.detail-1.heading: Use the supported modes
sections.detail-1.body: Its current listing supports repeated diagonal marks, one centered mark, page previews and adjustable text appearance. Processing stays on device and exports a new marked PDF. This guide compares layout choices within a page; our separate checks cover missing pages and watermark wording.
faqs.reader-question-1.heading: Which style is better for a dense financial table?
faqs.reader-question-1.body: Try the style that leaves its numbers easiest to read. Check the actual file or a print proof, since a visually lighter mark can still obscure small text.
faqs.reader-question-2.heading: Do repeated marks stop someone from copying the PDF?
faqs.reader-question-2.body: No. They increase visible coverage. Use the recipient’s required handling controls separately.

steps.step-1.text: Keep the unmarked original. Open a copy from Files in PDF Watermark & Stamp and enter short, specific wording.
steps.step-2.text: Choose the repeated diagonal or single centered style. Adjust available size, color and opacity while reviewing the real page content.
steps.step-3.text: Export a new PDF and inspect dense text, signatures and pages with different orientations. Send the checked marked copy, not the original by mistake.
